MPDOUTPUT.HTTP_SECTION_DESC: Volumio serves what it plays as a stream any player on the network can open at http://<player address>:<port>/.
MPDOUTPUT.HTTP_ENABLE_DESC: Serve the stream from this player.
MPDOUTPUT.SERVERNAME_DESC: Shown by players that display the stream title.
MPDOUTPUT.ENCODER_HTTP_DESC: MP3 plays everywhere; Ogg Vorbis and Opus carry track titles in the stream; FLAC is lossless and needs more bandwidth.
MPDOUTPUT.ENCODER_ICE_DESC: Ogg Vorbis and Opus carry track titles in the stream; with MP3 the titles are sent to the server separately.
MPDOUTPUT.BITRATE_DESC: Target bitrate of the encoded stream. Ignored for FLAC.
MPDOUTPUT.FORMAT_DESC: Sample rate, bit depth and channels the audio is converted to before encoding.
MPDOUTPUT.HTTP_PORT_DESC: TCP port the stream is served on (1–65535).
MPDOUTPUT.HTTP_ADVANCED_DESC: Client limit and the genre and website players may display.
MPDOUTPUT.MAX_CLIENTS_DESC: Number of players that may listen at once; 0 for no limit.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_SECTION_DESC: Volumio sends the stream to an Icecast server. If the server reboots or the network drops, the stream reconnects by itself; playback on this player is never affected.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_ENABLE_DESC: Send the stream to an Icecast server.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_HOST_DESC: Host name or IP address of the Icecast server.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_PORT_DESC: Port the Icecast server listens on, usually 8000.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_MOUNT_DESC: Path the stream is published under, for example /volumio.ogg. Must start with /.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_USER_DESC: Source user name on the server, usually source.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_PASSWORD_DESC: The server's source password for this mount.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_NAME_DESC: Name shown in the server's directory and by players.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_PUBLIC_DESC: Ask the server to advertise the stream in public directories.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_ADVANCED_DESC: Description, genre, website and the local feed port.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_URL_DESC: Web address shown with the stream.
MPDOUTPUT.ICE_FEED_PORT_DESC: Port on 127.0.0.1 where MPD hands the encoded stream to the relay. Change only if another service uses 8010.
MPDOUTPUT.RELAY_STATUS_DESC: Whether the relay is connected to MPD and to the server, and the last error if any.
MPDOUTPUT.NOTHING_ENABLED: Both streams are off. MPD runs without streaming outputs.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_PORT: {{field}} must be a port number between 1 and 65535.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_PORTS_DIFFER: The HTTP port and the local feed port must differ.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_MOUNT: The mount point must start with / and contain no spaces.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_TEXT: {{field}} must not contain quotes or line breaks.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_RELAY: The relay service could not be started: {{error}}
MPDOUTPUT.LEGACY_PROTOCOL: The {{protocol}} protocol is no longer offered; the stream is sent as Icecast 2.
MPDOUTPUT.STATUS_NOT_RUNNING: The relay service is not running.
MPDOUTPUT.STATUS_WAITING: Waiting for MPD to start playing; nothing has been sent yet.
MPDOUTPUT.STATUS_CONNECTING: Connected to MPD, connecting to the server{{error}}.
MPDOUTPUT.STATUS_CONNECTED: Streaming to {{host}}:{{port}}{{mount}} since {{since}}; {{reconnects}} reconnect(s) so far.
MPDOUTPUT.BACKUP_SECTION_DESC: Keeps a named copy of all settings on the player, outside the plugin, so it survives an uninstall and can be restored later or on another player.
MPDOUTPUT.BACKUP_NAME_DOC: 1 to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens. An existing name is overwritten.
MPDOUTPUT.RESTORE_SECTION_DESC: Replaces all settings with the chosen backup and applies them. Backups live in /data/INTERNAL/mpdoutput/backups — visible as the Internal Storage share — so a file copied there from another player appears here.
MPDOUTPUT.BACKUP_SELECTED_DOC: The backup file contains the Icecast source password; keep it private.
MPDOUTPUT.BACKUP_DELETE_SECTION_DESC: Removes the chosen backup file from the player.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_BACKUP_NAME: The backup name must be 1 to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_BACKUP_MISSING: That backup is not on this player.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_BACKUP_INVALID: That file is not a settings backup of this plugin.
MPDOUTPUT.ERR_BACKUP_WRITE: The backup could not be written: {{error}}
